name: topo-local-context
description: Use governed local TOPO context from Claude Desktop and propose reviewable memory candidates.
long_description: Connect Claude Desktop to a running TOPO Desktop instance. Claude can request purpose-bound confirmed context and search confirmed memory only when context sharing is enabled in TOPO. It can propose candidate memories only when contribution access is separately enabled. Claude never receives confirmation or rejection authority.

tools.name: topo_capabilities
tools.description: Check which TOPO local permissions are currently enabled.

tools.name: topo_context
tools.description: Request purpose-bound confirmed TOPO context for the current task.

tools.name: topo_search
tools.description: Search confirmed TOPO memory within the local sharing ceiling.

tools.name: topo_propose_claims
tools.description: Propose reviewable candidate memories; this never confirms memory.
